# S372 — Local roles: a smaller read cap

*Proposed.* Owner direction 2026-11-16 (relay session 8d711f67, interactive question, "Smaller reads"): a local role's Read cap is lower than 500 lines, so one session spends less of its window on one big file and greps first.

Owner decision 2026-11-16 (`roles.local-read-cap`): the implementer is capped at 150 lines with the Grep-and-window denial, and read-only roles stay at 500 with today's denial.

**Findings:** S304 trial 5 (2026-11-16, run ork-20261116-012801-28aa, S246): sessions restarted at 70k after 28-34 turns; most of the window was 500-line chunks of internal/daemon/runs.go (over 2,000 lines). The approval point caps a local Read at 500 lines (`internal/agent/claude/pretool.go:117-133`, S356). · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-11-16** — The implementer Read cap is 150 lines with the Grep-and-window denial. Read-only roles stay at 500 lines with the previous denial. The cap is role-keyed on the claude local approval hook, stored from the round role, and named in the local prompt, brief, design doc, and changelog.
